review.notes: Full review. One P2: the 5.2 PotentialIso-transfer bullet is stated for every language, but its only supplier (TauCeti.PotentialIso.infEquivAt) and InfinitaryLogic's Karp theory are relational (R01). Previous R01, R02 and R07 repaired; R03-R06 partly. Checked: gate rerun (all counters 0, OK), depcheck (0 problems), elaboration (29 sorry warnings only), 52 signatures, padding probes, 77 pinned names #checked, the 15 sampled targets against Marker's 2013 notes, the Keisler-Knight preprint and Erdos-Rado 1956 (21 locators), cross-roadmap citations on main, an ownership search by object across open PRs, and a 42-row adversarial table.
